# Captured control catalogue

**STATUS: RESEARCH, 2026-10-04.** Generated by `audit/catalogue.py`.

Read [methodology, source versions and Linux-series legend](README.md) before interpreting this table. All 129 direct IDs are included once. **No row is established as Windows-only.** These are GSP management messages, including userspace-ioctl-driven requests; they are not passthrough UMD GPU methods or an automatic implementation backlog. See [Linux refusal consequences](linux-refusals/README.md) and [existing v3 context/ZBC policy](v3-context-policy.md). Q/R counts are independent; lengths are declared parameter lengths. Reply statuses are inner RM status, not outer RPC status. Source structure sizes come from the selected public version, not inference from the capture.
